description: MLB player season stats (hitting or pitching) and bio from the official MLB Stats API (statsapi.mlb.com). Input is the MLB person id; season stats only, no game feed. Free public data, MLB copyright applies. Related tools on this server, for a different need: sports_mlb_statsapi when you need MLB games for one date from the official MLB Stats API; sports_nba_stats when you need NBA player season statistics, sorted leaderboard: per. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
